slides.headline: 6 signs that Glassdoor review wasn't written by someone who worked for you
Wrong location.
slides.body: An office or site you've never had.

slides.headline: The timeline doesn't fit.
slides.body: “Five years here” at a company that's three years old.

slides.headline: It names managers or teams you've never had.
It describes a process you don't run.
slides.body: Shifts, tools or policies that were never part of the job.

slides.headline: It sounds like another review word for word.
slides.body: Same phrases, same grievances, different title.

slides.headline: Two or more of these? It's worth a second look.
Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
